name: Berendezés azonosító
definition: Equipment and model identifier
notes: Model-specific product retrieval required.

name: Hőteljesítmény
definition: Available thermal heating capacity at an operating point
notes: Operating-point source data required; no generic scaling.

name: Teljes egység villamos input
definition: Whole heat-pump unit electrical input at an operating point
notes: Compressor-only input is not accepted as total system input.

name: Operating-point COP
definition: Useful thermal output divided by total unit electrical input
notes: Derived only when two source-supported values exist.

name: COP kerekítési tolerancia
definition: Explicit absolute tolerance for consistency checks on displayed source values
notes: 0.05 absolute COP tolerance for two-decimal manufacturer tables; larger mismatch fails validation.

name: Minimum modulation
definition: Source-native minimum thermal modulation capacity at an explicitly identified product and operating coordinate
notes: P23 adds a second-manufacturer source-native floor surface: Dimplex LA 2030CP has 15 exact minimum-output points. Mitsubishi remains the broad 40-point surface. Exact rows are OBS; interior values are DER only inside complete, non-barrier cells.

name: Külső hőmérséklet
definition: Canonical hourly outdoor temperature projected from source-native HungaroMet ta
notes: ta is the previous-hour mean and remains OBS in the source layer; no imputation or silent t/ta substitution.

name: Térfűtési hőigény
definition: Externally supplied hourly space-heating demand
notes: B02/B06 interface; no floor-area-only inference.

name: HMV hőigény
definition: Externally supplied hourly domestic-hot-water demand
notes: Separate from space heating.

name: Előremenő hőmérséklet
definition: Required supply-water temperature
notes: Low/medium/high cases are explicit scenarios

name: Backup hatásfok
definition: Explicit backup thermal-to-electric efficiency
notes: Only usable when backup is explicitly enabled and labelled.

name: Defrost modell státusza
definition: Whether evidence-backed weather-driven defrost runtime model is available
notes: P33 resolves exact NIBE S2125 controller state and telemetry in bounded scope but not ambient-weather-only frequency or event heat/electric energy. Generic weather-driven runtime remains Q.

name: Defrost elszámolási határ
definition: For explicitly EN14511-tagged points defrost effects occurring within the rating interval are part of heating-capacity/effective-input accounting
notes: P14: EN14511_RATED_POINT -> NO_EXTRA_UNIVERSAL_DEFROST_PENALTY. This does not assert that every point experienced an actual defrost event; unknown test basis remains Q and NIBE P10 continuous curves explicitly exclude defrost.

name: Defrost runtime penalty
definition: Separate weather-driven heat-pump electricity or heat penalty attributable to defrost
notes: P33 can identify bounded NIBE defrost state but manufacturer sources do not provide event heat removal or event electrical energy. No event kWh is invented; Vaillant UK 12-15% remains context only.

name: Mért Cdh
definition: Product-specific certified or regulated-product cycling degradation coefficient on a measurement-determined EN14825 basis
notes: P23 adds current Dimplex LA 2030CP average-climate low-temperature non-default bins -7=0.990,+2=0.970,+7=0.953,+12=0.912, independently corroborating multi-bin measurement-determined Cdh behavior on a second surface manufacturer. No hourly Cdh interpolation.

name: Regulatory Cdh default
definition: Regulatory default degradation coefficient when Cdh is not determined by measurement
notes: Cdh=0.9 is a compliance-method default only; never an OBS product value or automatic runtime penalty.

name: Cycling runtime penalty
definition: Separate B05 hourly efficiency correction attributable to below-minimum-modulation cycling
notes: P24 separates standard-bin Cdh validation from generic hourly physical runtime. Hourly B05 no longer requires a continuous Cdh(T) mapping; it requires explicit on/off transient parameters before a numeric penalty can be applied. Residual: HOURLY_ONOFF_TRANSIENT_PARAMETER_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED.

name: Szezonális szimulált COP
definition: Useful heat delivered by heat pump divided by heat-pump electricity
notes: Not an EN 14825 declared SCOP.

name: Szimulált SPF
definition: Useful heat including backup divided by total electricity
notes: Boundary explicitly includes backup when enabled.

name: Órás villamos csúcs
definition: Maximum hourly average electrical power
notes: Not instantaneous or sub-hourly start peak.

name: Kapacitáshiány
definition: Required thermal capacity minus heat-pump and explicit backup capacity
notes: Non-negative and separately auditable.

name: Órás leadott hő
definition: Hourly useful heat delivered by heat pump and explicit backup
notes: Power multiplied by explicit timestep; backup remains separate in the output ledger.

name: Órás hőszivattyú-villamos energia
definition: Hourly electricity consumed by the heat pump
notes: Total-unit input boundary.

name: Órás backup-villamos energia
definition: Hourly electricity consumed by explicit backup
notes: Zero when backup is disabled.

name: Órás összes villamos energia
definition: Hourly heat-pump plus backup electricity
notes: No tariff conversion inside B05.

name: Magyar 1-in-10 és extrém hideg bizonyíték
definition: Authoritative Hungarian definition and series for cold scenarios
notes: Observed 72-hour event exists; official 1-in-10 return-period definition remains Q and synthetic scenario labels remain SCN.

name: ta órás átlaghőmérséklet
definition: Source-native previous-hour mean air temperature
notes: Canonical B05 weather projection input; UTC timestamp preserved.

name: t pillanatnyi hőmérséklet
definition: Source-native hourly instantaneous air temperature
notes: Kept distinct from ta; not used as canonical hourly energy temperature.

name: u pillanatnyi relatív nedvesség
definition: Source-native instantaneous relative humidity
notes: Preserved for future defrost evidence; no defrost penalty in P3.

name: Cycling capacity ratio
definition: Required heat load divided by the exact cycling capacity used for the degradation method
notes: P18: require 0<CR<1 and a cycling capacity already qualified by P16/P17. CR is not market weighting and does not authorize modulation-floor interpolation.

name: COP at cycling capacity
definition: Source-supported COPd explicitly paired to the same product/coordinate/capacity used as the cycling-capacity denominator
notes: P23 adds second-manufacturer exact minimum-point COP at Dimplex A-7/W35=3.6, A2/W35=4.7 and A7/W35=5.3. Generic status remains Q outside qualified exact/bounded product domains.

name: Cycling-adjusted COP
definition: EN14825-based to-water COPbin after Cdh/CR adjustment at a qualified certification or standard-method bin
notes: P24 reclassifies COPbin as the EN14825/DEAP standard-bin validation track. Exact supported bins remain usable; arbitrary-hour Cdh interpolation is explicitly forbidden and generic hourly runtime follows the separate HEM/EN15316-style on/off path.

name: Cycling input co-location status
definition: Whether exact modulation floor, point-paired COPd and qualified product Cdh coexist for the same product and operating coordinate
notes: P23 independently reproduces exact co-location on Dimplex LA 2030CP at A-7/W35, A2/W35 and A7/W35. Generic continuous-hour status remains Q.

name: Modulation-floor surface
definition: Bounded same-product minimum continuous heating-output surface derived only inside complete rectangular sets of source-native floor corners
notes: P23 establishes two independent manufacturer surfaces. Mitsubishi: broad piecewise Data Book grid. Dimplex LA 2030CP: 15 exact points / 6 qualified cells with A-10 C retained as an explicit source-gap barrier. No cross-product transfer.

name: Minimum-point COP surface
definition: Same-product COP at the source-native minimum heating-capacity operating point, with bounded bilinear DER only inside complete Data Book cells
notes: P22 materializes 40 exact PUZ-WM50VHA(-BS) minimum-capacity/COP pairs and permits coordinate-bounded interpolation of both fields only within 27 complete grid cells. No blank-cell filling or cross-product transfer.

name: Hourly load ratio
definition: Required heat load divided by available operating-condition heat-pump capacity for the timestep
notes: P24 hourly path. Used to determine continuous versus on/off operation; bounded by the existing capacity/runtime gate.

name: Minimum continuous compressor power
definition: Electrical compressor power at the minimum continuous operating point
notes: P24: may be derived only where minimum continuous capacity and same-point minimum COP/input are qualified. No nominal-power substitution.

name: Heat-pump on/off transient parameter
definition: Characteristic heat-pump parameter representing on/off transient inertia
notes: P28 keeps product-specific tau_eq Q. HEM defines tau_eq as a heat-pump on/off transient characteristic, but checked exact-product public PCDB pages for Mitsubishi PUZ-WM50VHA and Dimplex LA 2030CP do not expose a tau_eq value. This does not prove internal/submitted data absence. Canonical residual: PRODUCT_OR_LAB_TRANSIENT_TEST_RECORD_REQUIRED. Cdh, minimum modulation, anti-cycling controller time and HEM default 140 s are forbidden substitutes for product OBS tau_eq.

name: Emitter response time
definition: Operating time characteristic of the emitter/distribution system used by the on/off transient method
notes: P31 separates policy authority from physical observation. The current HEM document/code fan-coil divergence no longer blocks an explicit OBS path, but the generic physical emitter response remains Q until an exact emitter/manufacturer/lab response-time source is supplied. HEM document 1370 s and reference-code 360 s remain POL-only alternatives.

name: Hourly on/off inertia power
definition: Additional compressor power attributable to below-minimum-load on/off transient behavior
notes: P24 formula authority exists, but runtime output stays Q until tau_eq and emitter response-time inputs are qualified.

name: HEM default on/off transient parameter
definition: Explicit standard-method/default-scenario tau_eq used only when the HEM default policy is selected
notes: P25 canonical default-scenario value = 140 s. Historical UK CALCM defines it explicitly as default and current HEM reference examples use it. This is POL/default, never product OBS. Generic VAR-B05-ONOFF-TRANSIENT-TAU-EQ remains Q for product-specific physical runtime.

name: HEM default emitter response time
definition: Emitter-class response-time mapping for explicit HEM method/policy scenarios
notes: P25 bounded agreement remains radiator/UFH wet=1370 s, warm air=120 s and DHW/storage=1560 s. P31 keeps fan coil source-specific: HEM-TP-12 v3 document branch=1370 s POL; current reference-code commit 5a3ac972 branch=360 s POL. No generic fan-coil default is selected.

name: HEM default-scenario hourly on/off inertia power
definition: Hourly on/off transient power under explicit HEM_DEFAULT_SCENARIO parameter policy
notes: P25 executable only after proven below-minimum state, qualified minimum compressor power, explicit supported emitter class and explicit HEM_DEFAULT_SCENARIO selection. Not product OBS and not a Hungarian regulatory default.

name: DHW controller policy
definition: Exact product/controller-bound DHW versus space-heating dispatch semantics
notes: P29 proves bounded controller semantics for two exact systems. The generic variable remains Q until a controller identity/configuration is explicitly selected; no policy is transferred across products.

name: DHW controller runtime state
definition: State required to determine request, restriction, simultaneous-operation and mode-transition status at the timestep
notes: P32 resolves a bounded Dimplex WPM Touch state machine from explicit tank temperature, DHW setpoint, hysteresis, prior request state and current HP-maximum temperature. The generic variable remains Q because Mitsubishi and cross-controller state semantics are not universalized.

name: DHW high-temperature product performance
definition: Product-specific thermal capacity, total electrical input and COP at the DHW operating temperature actually dispatched
notes: P32 proves bounded source-native high-temperature performance for exact LA2030CP at W65: min/max Qh, Pel and COP at nine exact outdoor temperatures. Generic status remains Q outside that exact product/temperature/level grid; operating limit alone remains forbidden as performance evidence.

name: Visszatérő vízhőmérséklet
definition: Heat-pump water return/inlet temperature associated with an operating condition
notes: P30: return temperature may be exact test/control metadata. It becomes a performance coordinate only after the hydraulic-axis admissibility gate proves source-native same-product variation at matched outdoor/supply conditions. Current canonical performance snapshot contains no populated return-temperature values.

name: Vízoldali hőfoklépcső
definition: Flow/supply minus return/inlet water temperature difference for the same operating condition
notes: P30: delta-T may be explicit source metadata or derived for audit from source-native supply and return values, but a derived delta-T does not independently prove COP/capacity sensitivity. With supply retained, return and delta-T are algebraically equivalent hydraulic coordinates and cannot both be independent axes.

name: Hydraulic performance-axis admissibility
definition: Whether return temperature or delta-T has source-native independent performance-grid authority for the exact product/unit boundary
notes: P30 current canonical result = NOT_ADMITTED_NO_SOURCE_NATIVE_AXIS_VALUES. This is a current evidence result, not a permanent prohibition; future exact product grids may pass the executable gate.

name: Fan-coil HEM document-policy response time
definition: Source-specific fan-coil response time when explicitly running the HEM-TP-12 v3 document interpretation
notes: P31 value = 1370 s because HEM-TP-12 v3 states the current methodology uses Light embedded for all heat pumps with wet distribution. This is a source-specific POL branch, not product/emitter OBS.

name: Fan-coil HEM reference-code response time
definition: Source-specific fan-coil response time when explicitly reproducing current official reference implementation commit 5a3ac9728df712332a5625571c43d3bc10bd2bf3
notes: P31 value = 360 s from TIME_CONSTANT_SPACE_FAN_COILS in the pinned current reference implementation. This is a code-reproduction POL branch, not product/emitter OBS.

name: Fan-coil OBS emitter response time
definition: Exact fan-coil/emitter-system response time admitted from explicit manufacturer or laboratory transient evidence
notes: P31 creates the independent OBS path. Neither 1370 s document policy nor 360 s reference-code policy can populate this variable. Closure requires exact emitter/model/system-bound transient evidence with source identity.

name: Dimplex current DHW HP maximum temperature
definition: Current maximum DHW temperature the WPM Touch calculates as attainable by heat-pump operation based on heat-source temperature
notes: P32 runtime-state input. It must be supplied from current controller state; the model does not invent the heat-source-temperature-to-HP-maximum mapping.

name: Dimplex DHW request state
definition: Stateful WPM Touch DHW request derived from tank temperature effective heat-pump target hysteresis and previous request state
notes: P32: request starts below effective target minus hysteresis and remains pending through the deadband until the effective heat-pump target is reached. Effective target is min(DHW setpoint current HP maximum).

name: Dimplex W65 performance level
definition: Explicit source-table level selecting the exact LA2030CP W65 minimum or maximum performance row
notes: P32 does not infer the runtime inverter level from demand. MIN or MAX must be explicit before a unique W65 Qh/Pel/COP point is selected.

name: Dimplex LA2030CP W65 DHW performance
definition: Exact source-native high-temperature Qh Pel and COP for LA2030CP at water outlet 65 C and an admitted exact outdoor-temperature/performance-level coordinate
notes: P32 canonical grid contains 18 points: 9 exact outdoor temperatures x MIN/MAX. A-22/W65 is blank in the source and is not materialized; no interpolation or graph digitization.

name: NIBE S2125 defrost controller state
definition: Exact NIBE S2125 off active passive or requirement-pending state from controller semantics or direct telemetry
notes: P33 bounded product-family state. Direct Modbus Defrost status is OBS; derived state classification requires explicit controller timer/config/sensor inputs and never infers BT16 from ambient RH.

name: NIBE S2125 defrost telemetry
definition: Source-native S2125/F2120 Modbus channels for BT28 BT16 compressor frequency and Defrost status
notes: P33 direct observational path. Slave-1 register map is materialized for audit; Defrost status 0=off 1=active 2=passive.

name: NIBE S2125 defrost event heat/electric energy
definition: Heat removed and electrical energy attributable to an exact active or passive defrost event
notes: P34 narrows the residual to a co-timed same-system raw series containing direct Defrost state and explicit electrical/thermal measurement boundaries. Public field/dashboard evidence is not promoted to numeric OBS event kWh without that joined series.

name: Ambient weather to NIBE BT16 mapping
definition: Product-specific relation mapping ambient temperature/humidity and operating state to S2125 evaporator-in temperature BT16
notes: P33 forbids ambient T/RH -> defrost inference without BT16 telemetry or a qualified product-specific mapping. Hungarian relative humidity remains preserved input only.

name: NIBE defrost event-energy admission gate
definition: Executable fail-closed contract for admitting event kWh only from a complete same-system co-timed direct defrost event and explicit electrical/thermal measurements
notes: P34 contract. Requires explicit event identity, direct OFF->ACTIVE/PASSIVE->OFF boundary authority, OBS state/electric/thermal streams, source-ordered contiguous INTERVAL_MEAN rows, same system identity, explicit invariant meter boundaries and explicit thermal sign convention.

name: NIBE co-timed defrost state and energy series
definition: Raw same-system series joining direct Defrost state with electrical and thermal measurements on common event intervals
notes: P34 acquisition residual. Dashboard/event observations and API availability do not equal an admitted joined raw event series.

name: NIBE instantaneous used-power channel
definition: Current NIBE S-Series common Modbus register exposing used power with compressor and addition
notes: Register 2166, factor 10. Channel availability is OBS manufacturer evidence; P34 has not acquired a co-timed event value series.

name: NIBE thermal energy measurement channels
definition: Current NIBE S-Series common Modbus cumulative flow-energy channels for compressor including addition and compressor-only heat/hot-water paths
notes: Registers include 1575,1577,1583,1585 with source-native kWh units/factors. Channel availability does not prove per-defrost signed heat loss; meter semantics and event boundary must be explicit before delta use.
